Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: This step is the entry point of the primary loop where the agent attempts to scrape a PDF directly, encounters a 403 error, and fails to successfully retrieve the foundational list of 1959 standards. The Subtask Name: Identify Relevant Standards from 1959
Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: Locate the 1959 standards document and extract items from the "dried and dehydrated section" marked as dehydrated and items in the "Frozen/Chilled section" containing the whole name of the item, excluding those marked as "Chilled."
Evidence: Steps 0-2 involve the Orchestrator defining the plan, the WebServing_Expert proposing a search for the 1959 standards, and attempting to access the document via a PDF link and Archive.org.
Loop Info:
{
  is_loop_related: false,
  loop_role: none,
  loop_group_id: null,
  reversibility: reversible,
  loop_risk_score: 0.1
}

The Subtask Name: Determine Superseded Standards
Step Range: 3-10
The Oracle: Identify which of the relevant standards identified in the previous step have been superseded by a new version as of August 2023 by searching for updates, removal lists, and cross-referencing with USDA resources.
Evidence: Steps 3-10 involve multiple attempts by WebServing_Expert and Verification_Expert to search for superseded standards, access removal lists (AMS USDA, Federal Register), and review documents, resulting in repeated cycles of searching without successful data extraction.
Loop Info:
{
  is_loop_related: true,
  loop_role: internal,
  loop_group_id: L1,
  reversibility: reversible,
  loop_risk_score: 0.9
}

The Subtask Name: Calculate Percentage of Superseded Standards
Step Range: 11-12
The Oracle: Calculate the percentage of the identified relevant standards that have been superseded using the formula (superseded_standards / total_standards) * 100 and round to the nearest percent.
Evidence: Steps 11-12 involve the WebServing_Expert summarizing the approach and the Orchestrator acknowledging the task remains incomplete due to lack of data, indicating the calculation step was planned but not executed due to missing information.
Loop Info:
{
  is_loop_related: false,
  loop_role: none,
  loop_group_id: null,
  reversibility: reversible,
  loop_risk_score: 0.0
}

  -- Thought: Since direct scraping failed, the agent decided to search for a text-based version or summary of the 1959 standards on Archive.org.
  -- Result: Identified a potential source on Archive.org (https://archive.org/details/unitedstatesstan14unit_4) containing the 1959 standards document.
